scenarios.prompt: Compute safety stock and reorder point with combined demand and lead-time variability. avg daily demand = 120 units, sd_demand = 35, avg lead time = 7 days, sd_lead_time = 2 days, service level = 95%. Formula: SS = z × sqrt(LT × sd_d^2 + d^2 × sd_LT^2). Report safety_stock, reorder_point, z_score.

Same inputs as before (d=120, sd_d=35, LT=7, sd_LT=2) but service level = 99%. Compute safety_stock, reorder_point, z_score. Trap: going from 95% to 99% is NOT a small increment — the z-score jumps from 1.645 to 2.326, and safety stock should rise ~40%.
